scope: Authored, public-source learning vocabulary and scoped scheme discovery; no provider payloads or complete-domain claim. Definitions are project paraphrases. Alias authority describes the exact lexical form, not the definition.

terms.label: Local authority
terms.definition: A local-government organisation; its administrative area is a separate geographic object.
terms.scopeNote: The local-government structure and relevant tier depend on nation and date. A council and a local authority district are not interchangeable identities.

terms.label: Local authority district
terms.definition: An administrative geography used in names, codes and statistical products.
terms.scopeNote: Keep the nation, geography code and boundary date; a district label does not identify every local-government tier.

terms.label: Output Area
terms.definition: A small area used to publish Census statistics.
terms.scopeNote: Select the nation and Census geography vintage. An area describes a population aggregate, not an individual.

terms.label: Lower layer Super Output Area
terms.definition: A statistical geography made from groups of Output Areas in England and Wales.
terms.scopeNote: A 2011 code or boundary cannot silently stand in for a 2021 one.

terms.label: Middle layer Super Output Area
terms.definition: A statistical geography made from groups of Lower layer Super Output Areas in England and Wales.
terms.scopeNote: A hierarchy join needs the matching published lookup and vintage.

terms.label: Built-up area
terms.definition: A geography representing an area of built development.
terms.scopeNote: State the provider, definition and edition. ONS statistical BUAs and OS product features must not be treated as identical from their name alone.

terms.label: Unique Property Reference Number
terms.definition: A persistent identifier for an addressable location.
terms.scopeNote: An addressable location need not be a building; the number is not a geometry or a household count.

terms.label: Unique Street Reference Number
terms.definition: A persistent identifier for a street curated by local-authority custodians.
terms.scopeNote: A street record is not the same object as a Road Link or Path Link.

terms.label: Topographic Identifier
terms.definition: An OS feature identifier also supplied as an optional secondary identifier in much of NGD.
terms.scopeNote: Its presence is not guaranteed on every NGD feature. A TOID lookup needs an identified feature type and source version.

terms.label: OS Identifier
terms.definition: The primary persistent identifier used for many OS NGD features.
terms.scopeNote: Uniqueness is at feature-type level: the same OSID may identify related representations in different feature types.

terms.label: OS National Geographic Database
terms.definition: OS data organised into themes, collections and feature types.
terms.scopeNote: Feature type, schema version, collection and data release are separate identifiers.

terms.label: Public Sector Geospatial Agreement
terms.definition: The agreement under which OS provides geospatial data and services to eligible public-sector organisations.
terms.scopeNote: This glossary does not establish an account entitlement, licence permission or authority for a provider request.

terms.label: OS Linked Identifiers
terms.definition: An OS service and product family describing typed relationships between identifiers.
terms.scopeNote: A correlation is not identity, containment or a claim that an address is a building. Preserve method, direction, source and target versions.

terms.label: Road Link
terms.definition: A linear feature representing a section of a road network between network points.
terms.scopeNote: Read the feature schema and network references; a line on a map alone does not prove routability.

terms.label: Path Link
terms.definition: A linear feature representing a section of the Path Network between network points.
terms.scopeNote: Coverage has documented inclusion and exclusion rules. The name alone does not establish a public right of way.

terms.label: Code History Database
terms.definition: ONS reference data about geography codes, relationships, hierarchies and archived geographies.
terms.scopeNote: A successor relationship or equivalence must be evidenced by its own source row; it is not inferred from a similar name.

terms.label: Register of Geographic Codes
terms.definition: An ONS published register of geography codes.
terms.scopeNote: Use the selected edition and documented entity/instance fields. This glossary does not enumerate the register or infer a code’s current validity.

terms.label: GSS geography code
terms.definition: A code used under the Government Statistical Service geography coding and naming policy.
terms.scopeNote: Retain entity family, instance, nation and date. Similar strings in another provider’s field do not prove the same coding scheme.

terms.label: ONS UPRN Directory
terms.definition: A directory allocating UPRNs to administrative and other geographies using their positions.
terms.scopeNote: Consult the edition guide for allocation exceptions and derived fields; do not replace it with NSUL best-fit memberships.

terms.label: National Statistics UPRN Lookup
terms.definition: A lookup allocating source UPRNs to Output Areas and higher statistical geographies by best fit.
terms.scopeNote: The higher-area assignment is an OA-based statistical method, not necessarily direct point-in-polygon membership. Check the edition and lifecycle scope; this explanation does not establish counts of current or terminated properties in a retained selection.

terms.label: Output Area Classification
terms.definition: A classification grouping areas with similar demographic and socioeconomic characteristics.
terms.scopeNote: Preserve the classification edition, nation, tier and native labels. Categories describe areas, not individual residents.

terms.label: Rural Urban Classification
terms.definition: A statistical classification of areas by settlement and accessibility characteristics.
terms.scopeNote: England/Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland use distinct products, editions and geographic units. Codes and labels are not shared aliases across these schemes.

terms.label: Index of Multiple Deprivation
terms.definition: A relative area-level measure combining several domains of deprivation.
terms.scopeNote: Name the national scheme and edition. A rank is neither an amount of deprivation nor an individual characteristic.

terms.label: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation
terms.definition: The Welsh Government’s measure of relative deprivation for small areas in Wales.
terms.scopeNote: WIMD 2025 is a distinct scheme; do not compare its ranks directly with ranks from another nation.

terms.label: Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation
terms.definition: Scotland’s area-based measure of multiple deprivation.
terms.scopeNote: Identify the edition and revision. Data-zone ranks are not English LSOA ranks.

terms.label: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure
terms.definition: Northern Ireland’s measure ranking areas by multiple deprivation.
terms.scopeNote: The cited NIMDM 2017 scheme uses its own SOAs and seven domains; it is not an alias for the English IMD.

terms.label: Geography Markup Language
terms.definition: An OGC XML encoding for geographic information.
terms.scopeNote: GML version and application schema determine field meaning; converting geometry does not prove all attributes survive.

terms.label: YAML-LD
terms.definition: Conventions for representing Linked Data in YAML using JSON-LD semantics.
terms.scopeNote: The cited 2023 document is a final Community Group report, not a W3C Recommendation. Project safe-parser restrictions remain additional.

terms.label: Just-in-time learning
terms.definition: Project shorthand for explaining relevant concepts, evidence and choices when a task needs them.
terms.scopeNote: A project learning term, not an OS/ONS code list or a claim that a live retrieval took place.

terms.label: Epoch
terms.definition: A time reference whose meaning depends on the source system.
terms.scopeNote: A geodetic reference epoch and an AddressBase numbered release epoch are different roles. Never merge them merely because the word matches.

terms.label: Geodetic datum
terms.definition: A reference that connects a coordinate system to the Earth.
terms.scopeNote: Keep geodetic and height datums separate; neither is merely a map projection.

terms.label: Coordinate reference system
terms.definition: A system relating coordinate values to locations through specified reference and coordinate-system definitions.
terms.scopeNote: Preserve axes, units, dimensionality, datum and identifier. EPSG:27700 and EPSG:7405 are distinct.

terms.label: Full supply
terms.definition: A supply mode providing the selected product’s full content for the stated delivery.
terms.scopeNote: Full applies to the declared selection and product; it is not proof of national coverage or all product families.

terms.label: Change-only update
terms.definition: A supply containing changes since a preceding product version.
terms.scopeNote: Interpret insert, update/replace and delete under the product specification and ordered baseline; do not treat a change file as a standalone complete holding.

terms.label: Controlled vocabulary
terms.definition: A managed set of terms, labels or codes within a stated scheme.
terms.scopeNote: The permitted labels in one field are not automatically the permitted labels in another.

terms.label: Native field
terms.definition: A source’s own named attribute or property.
terms.scopeNote: Retain spelling, case, type, owner feature/schema and nullability. A friendly display label does not change the native identifier.

terms.label: Preferred label
terms.definition: A selected lexical label for a concept in a specified language.
terms.scopeNote: Project display labels and source-authoritative labels must have separate provenance; unknown language stays unknown.

terms.label: Search variant
terms.definition: An alternative text form used to help find an existing term.
terms.scopeNote: A search match is not an identity assertion. Project variants are labelled as such and never generate equivalence.

terms.label: Exact concept mapping
terms.definition: A strong SKOS mapping between concepts in different schemes.
terms.scopeNote: Requires reviewed evidence and scope. SKOS exactMatch is transitive; shared strings do not justify it.

terms.label: SKOS-XL
terms.definition: The SKOS extension that represents lexical labels as resources.
terms.scopeNote: Useful when labels need their own provenance or history. Each label has one literal form; identical text does not identify one label resource.

terms.label: Data Catalog Vocabulary
terms.definition: An RDF vocabulary for describing datasets, distributions and data services.
terms.scopeNote: DCAT 3 describes catalogue resources; it does not establish semantic equivalence between their values.

terms.label: Provenance
terms.definition: Information about the entities, activities and agents involved in producing something.
terms.scopeNote: A derivation relation does not certify correctness, rights or independent review.

terms.label: Web Ontology Language
terms.definition: A language for expressing formal classes, properties, individuals and logical relationships.
terms.scopeNote: OWL identity or class-equivalence assertions are stronger than navigation and should not be generated from label similarity.

terms.label: Sensor, Observation, Sample, and Actuator
terms.definition: A vocabulary for observations, their features of interest, properties, procedures and results.
terms.scopeNote: An observation event is not a code-list concept or a Census area classification. Keep phenomenon time and result time distinct.

terms.label: Unit of measure
terms.definition: A defined quantity standard used to express a measurement value.
terms.scopeNote: Preserve quantity kind, unit identity and conversion basis. A bare number, rank or code is not automatically a physical measurement.

terms.label: GeoSPARQL
terms.definition: An OGC vocabulary and query standard for geographic information represented in RDF.
terms.scopeNote: Using a term from the standard does not establish engine conformance or geometric equivalence.

schemes.label: NGD Address Classification Scheme
schemes.gap: Four documented levels; complete edition-bound code/definition enumeration and AddressBase correspondence not assessed here.

schemes.label: NGD Building Use
schemes.gap: Pipe-delimited up-to-two values and Mixed Use require a field representation rule, not a new fused concept.

schemes.label: NGD name language
schemes.gap: eng/gla/cym are ISO639-2 source codes; no automatic BCP47 conversion is asserted.

schemes.label: NGD Build Status
schemes.gap: Preserve v1 and v2 separately; actual feature-schema adoption must be checked.

schemes.label: NGD Positional Accuracy
schemes.gap: Low accuracy → Low Accuracy is a documented lexical change; preserve both edition-scoped forms.

schemes.label: NGD Road Classification
schemes.gap: Unofficial C-road wording is not an official replacement for Classified Unnumbered.

schemes.label: NGD Access Level
schemes.gap: Surface Level has a documented contextual difference from physicalLevel; do not merge concepts.

schemes.label: OS Linked Identifiers correlation methods
schemes.gap: Eleven method identifiers documented; source/target type/version and method-specific meaning remain required.

schemes.label: GSS geography entities and instances
schemes.edition: June 2026 catalogue entries observed; release/reference roles separate
schemes.gap: No whole-register code count or complete history claim; membership, successor and equivalence rows need their own evidence.

schemes.label: UK Output Area Classification
schemes.gap: Separate OAC, SOAC and LAD classification tiers and earlier OAC editions.

schemes.label: England and Wales Rural Urban Classification
schemes.gap: Full native code/label lookup not acquired; not equivalent to 2011 or Scotland2022.

schemes.label: Scottish Government Urban Rural Classification
schemes.gap: Preserve 2/3/6/8-fold scheme variants, geographic units and accessibility definitions.

schemes.label: English Indices of Deprivation
schemes.gap: Domain, rank, score, decile and population are distinct; no cross-nation or cross-edition rank equivalence.

schemes.label: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation
schemes.gap: The later series release is child-deprivation analysis, not evidence of a new classification edition. Full classification tables not acquired.

schemes.label: Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation
schemes.gap: Pin exact revision before use; statistics remain tied to their source geography.

schemes.label: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure
schemes.gap: SOA and other output geographies are distinct. This review does not prove no future replacement exists.

schemes.label: Coordinate reference systems and datums
schemes.gap: EPSG register edition and individual definition bytes not captured; named mappings need exact axis/unit/datum evidence.

schemes.label: QUDT units and quantity kinds
schemes.gap: Maintainer source checked, release not pinned; no field-level unit or conversion mapping admitted.

schemes.label: GeoSPARQL
schemes.gap: No reasoner or engine conformance tested.

schemes.label: SKOS and SKOS-XL
schemes.gap: A proposed label-provenance profile is separate from the current repository context.

schemes.label: DCAT
schemes.gap: Use for datasets/distributions/services; not concept identity.

schemes.label: PROV-O
schemes.gap: Evidence assertions need exact locators; vocabulary adoption is not verification.

schemes.label: OWL2
schemes.gap: No equivalentClass/sameAs inference admitted by this registry.

schemes.label: SOSA/SSN
schemes.edition: 2017 Recommendation baseline; later evolution not evaluated
schemes.gap: Use only for an evidenced observation model; not every data row is a sensor observation.

schemes.label: AddressBase classification scheme
schemes.gap: Product-specific depth differs. Full CSV/XLSX release was not downloaded. Shared example codes do not prove complete equivalence with a particular NGD schema/release.

schemes.label: UK Standard Industrial Classification
schemes.gap: Published framework is not yet operational across ONS systems; earliest planned use is 2031 Blue Book. Retained sic/sic-unofficial nodes do not specify complete edition/code adoption. Pin each dataset and correlation table separately.

schemes.label: Standard Occupational Classification
schemes.gap: Three volumes and related SOC 2010/ISCO/NS-SEC mappings are distinct. Job-title coding-index entries are not automatic synonyms for occupation concepts. Full code tables not downloaded.

schemes.label: Northern Ireland settlement and urban/rural classifications
schemes.edition: 2015 and 2005 products described; different Census references
schemes.gap: Do not reuse England/Wales RUC2021 or Scottish2022 codes. Complete settlement bands, lookups and any later replacement need separate review.

schemes.label: Nomis dataset-specific SDMX code lists
schemes.gap: Every retained component codelist reference is enumerated separately. Geography, time, measure and attribute lists have different roles. Target category lists were not all followed; code-list IDs carry dataset context.

schemes.label: ONS Census variable and category classifications
schemes.edition: Census2021 England and Wales; variable revisions separate
schemes.gap: Variable, classification variant, category code and population applicability are separate. All retained dimension references are enumerated; they do not close all categories or Census nations.

schemes.label: Census ethnic-group classifications
schemes.gap: Self-identified response and derived classification differ. The cited 20-category variable includes not-applicable; detailed and grouped classifications, 2011, Scotland and NI require separate sources. No ethnicity inferred from another field.

schemes.label: Census religion classification family
schemes.gap: Retained Nomis religion dimension identifiers and dataset titles are discovery evidence only. Exact question wording, voluntary/not-stated categories, code meanings, nation and edition need authoritative dictionary review before interpretation.

schemes.label: Other retained Census and labour-market categories
schemes.gap: Inventory includes age, sex, disability, economic activity, qualifications, household, language, nationality and other native dimension names. Names alone are not full definitions or cross-dataset equivalence.

collisions.distinction: Geodetic reference instant versus product release sequence.
Source/API feature-type forms are scoped to provider and version; matching spelling is not cross-product identity.
Provider product, statistical edition and geometry must remain explicit.
National schemes and editions are separate; ranks are not directly comparable.
NGD Access Level differs from physicalLevel despite identical text.
Native ISO639-2 code, BCP47 display-language tag, unknown and absent are different representations.

schemeInventoryScope: Scoped authored families plus separately enumerated retained nodes/routes; the family count is not a domain denominator.
